name: Cali Blaze Donut Blunt | Cherry Lime
description:
Tart cherry and sharp lime. Sativa-dominant, so expect an energetic, clear-headed start that's good for daytime use. The citrus terpenes hit first, then the cherry rounds it out on the exhale. Bright and clean.

The 1.2g Live Resin Donut. A kief-coated donut blunt with a premium glass tip, wrapped in natural hemp. Infused with live resin and rolled in kief.
